name: agentic-knowledge-graph
description: Local development commands only. This is NOT a build manifest: each portal and service owns its own dependencies and is deployed independently.

scripts.local:contracts:test: uv run --directory Libraries/python/akg-contracts --with pydantic --with pytest python -m pytest -q
scripts.local:catalog:run: uv run --directory Middleware/data-catalog --with fastapi --with 'uvicorn[standard]' --with sqlalchemy --with 'psycopg[binary]' --with pydantic-settings --with-editable . uvicorn data_catalog.app:app --port 9001 --reload
scripts.local:db:restart: docker restart akg-postgres && npm run local:db:migrate
scripts.local:start-all: npm run local:services:start && npm run local:ui:start-all
scripts.local:stop-all: npm run local:ui:stop-all && npm run local:services:stop
scripts.local:restart-all: npm run local:stop-all; npm run local:start-all
